decisions.decision: The COA granted the request for Eagle House building use for the Lunenburg Friendly Seniors Fall Fair (October 12 set-up, October 13, 2012, 8-4PM).

decisions.decision: A memo will be sent to the Selectmen's office requesting re-appointment of Jim Hays and Joyce Wass for another 3-year term.

decisions.decision: Meals on Wheels clients will be offered a frozen meal on Thursday to make up for the Friday meal, per the Director's plan.
decisions.quote: meals on wheels clients will be offered the option of receiving a frozen meal on thursday to make up for the friday meal.

decisions.decision: The Director will send the Meal Site Manager to a Serve Safe course in September.

decisions.decision: The Director will work directly with the Town Manager on revising job descriptions in the Salary Administration Plan.
decisions.quote: she will also be working directly with the town manager on revising job descriptions in the salary administration plan.
